overview: At this meeting, the City Council approved the Standard Compensation Ordinance on third reading and authorized several municipal and school appropriations. The council also tabled the proposed fiscal year 2027 budget and a free cash housing appropriation to their next meeting on June 23rd.

items.title: Approval of Records and Committee Reports
items.summary: Approved the minutes of previous regular and joint meetings and the Committee of the Whole reports on the fiscal year 2027 budget as amended.

items.title: Standard Compensation Ordinance (Paper 25189)
items.summary: Approved on third reading an ordinance creating a wage floor and successorship protections for contracted janitorial and security services, moving forward despite an administrative request to postpone.

items.title: Personnel Ordinance Amendments (Paper 26084)
items.summary: Approved on third reading the compensation classification adjustments aligning the Director of Elections, Director of Diversity Equity Inclusion, and Director of Veteran Services into the same compensation bracket.

items.title: Grant of Location: National Grid (Paper 26108)
items.summary: Approved a petition by National Grid to install an underground electrical conduit on Mystic Valley Parkway, subject to several conditions from the engineering department.

items.title: Extended Hours License: Coldstone Creamery (Paper 26109)
items.summary: Approved a common victualler's license amendment allowing Coldstone Creamery to remain open until 1:00 AM daily during the summer, subject to a 21-day review period.

items.title: Resolution on MBTA Bus Network Redesign (Paper 26110)
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting neighborhood communication on the MBTA's proposed bus route changes and urging the transit agency to hold an in-person meeting in Medford.

items.title: Board Appointment and Food Truck Permits (Papers 26111 & 26112)
items.summary: Approved the reappointment of Lisa Ann Davidson to the Affordable Housing Trust Fund Board and approved the food truck permit for June 13th while tabling subsequent dates.

items.title: Water and Sewer Fund Appropriation (Paper 26113)
items.summary: Approved the appropriation of $5.5 million from the Water and Sewer Enterprise Fund retained earnings to fund water main replacement projects.

items.title: School Stabilization Fund Appropriation (Paper 26114)
items.summary: Approved the transfer of $1,085,549 from the School Special Purpose Override Stabilization Fund to support school department budgets.

items.title: PEG Access Special Revenue Fund (Paper 26115)
items.summary: Approved the establishment of a PEG Access and Cable Related Special Revenue Fund starting in fiscal year 2027.

items.title: FY 2027 Budget Submission (Paper 26061)
items.summary: Tabled the proposed $217 million general fund budget and related enterprise budgets to June 23rd to allow for further review and to request more detailed information regarding legal expenditures.

items.title: Free Cash Appropriation: Affordable Housing Trust (Paper 26105)
items.summary: Tabled a pending free cash appropriation for the Affordable Housing Trust to the June 23rd meeting.
